prometheus_stopped.body:
# HELP horizon_up 1 while the game runs and answers
# TYPE horizon_up gauge
horizon_up 0
# HELP horizon_supervisor_uptime_seconds Seconds since horizon-server started
# TYPE horizon_supervisor_uptime_seconds gauge
horizon_supervisor_uptime_seconds <dynamic>
# HELP horizon_crashes Game crashes since horizon-server started
# TYPE horizon_crashes gauge
horizon_crashes 2
# HELP horizon_tps Ticks per second over the last 5 seconds
# TYPE horizon_tps gauge
horizon_tps 19.9
# HELP horizon_tps_target The tick rate the game aims for (/tick rate)
# TYPE horizon_tps_target gauge
horizon_tps_target 20
# HELP horizon_mspt Milliseconds per tick: the average and the percentiles /tick query reports
# TYPE horizon_mspt gauge
horizon_mspt{stat="average"} 8.25
horizon_mspt{stat="p50"} 7
horizon_mspt{stat="p95"} 12.5
horizon_mspt{stat="p99"} 18
# HELP horizon_players_online Players online
# TYPE horizon_players_online gauge
horizon_players_online 2
# HELP horizon_players_max max-players
# TYPE horizon_players_max gauge
horizon_players_max 20
# HELP horizon_chunks_loaded Chunks loaded
# TYPE horizon_chunks_loaded gauge
horizon_chunks_loaded 321
# HELP horizon_memory_rss_bytes The game process's resident memory
# TYPE horizon_memory_rss_bytes gauge
horizon_memory_rss_bytes 536870912
# HELP horizon_cpu_percent The game process's CPU use (100 = one core)
# TYPE horizon_cpu_percent gauge
horizon_cpu_percent 12.5
